senses.definition: A female who performs on the stage or in films.

quotes.text: A while ago somewhere I don't know when / I was watchin' a movie with a friend / I fell in love with the actress / She was playin' a part that I could understand
quotes.reference: 1972, Neil Young, “A Man Needs a Maid”, in Harvest:

quotes.text: "I'm an actress -- actor, as we have to say these days."
quotes.reference: 2010, Peter Corris, Torn Apart, Allen and Unwin, page 88:

quotes.text: Court documents appear to show that Ian Edmondson, a senior News of the World journalist, had authorised Mr Mulcaire to hack phones belonging to Sienna Miller, an actress.
quotes.reference: 2011 January 27, “Not going quietly”, in The Economist:

senses.definition: (now rare) A female doer or "actor" (in a general sense).

quotes.text: My mental anguish, and the dreadful scenes in which I had been an actress, advanced the period of my labour.
